last_checked.note: 2026-08-13 check: v6.0.0.27 (tag created/published 2026-08-10T16:53:47Z, but underlying commit 4b9cca4 dated 2026-08-07T21:52:15Z and first Datadog logs for this SHA start 2026-08-07T22:32:00Z -- used the commit/first-log date as release_date and queried from 2026-08-06 onward, not the later GitHub release-publish timestamp, since that would have missed 3 days of real deployment history) vs prior-checked v6.0.0.26 (2026-08-06). One intermediate release v6.1.0.5 (2026-08-07T16:33:42Z) shipped between checks and was skipped per the skill's stated behavior. Window covers ~6 days (2026-08-07 22:32 to now), much longer than the prior run's ~3h snapshot, so raw counts aren't directly comparable; used the Datadog logs/analytics/aggregate endpoint (group_by status) for exact totals since /events/search page limits only return samples up to the page size. Rollout is broad and healthy across 18 clusters (production x5 incl. new-since-last-check ap1a, staging x2, sandbox x1, 9 customer MPC/GCP clusters, preset x2). All 135 critical-status logs are 'WORKER TIMEOUT (pid:N)' -- already known_noise (Gunicorn worker recycling), just the first run where any showed up at critical severity instead of 0; not a new issue. Investigated the error volume (302,681 total, sampled up to 1000 by recency plus targeted counts for the biggest patterns): ~89k are authlib deprecation-warning stack-trace fragments split across 4 log lines each (already known_noise, mis-classified as error by the log pipeline as documented). ~53k are a literal one-word-for-word RENAME of an existing known_noise pattern -- 'Error while rendering virtual dataset query: list object has no element 0' (101,362 hits on the prior SHA, going back to 2026-07-01) has been replaced by 'Virtual dataset template error: list object has no element 0' (0 hits on the prior SHA, 53,036 hits on this SHA) -- same 'list object has no element 0' root cause, just reworded in this release; confirmed via direct before/after SHA queries and added the new string to known_noise rather than flagging as a new bug. Remaining ~160k errors are long-tail unique messages not fully enumerated in this pass (limited by the 1000-line sample); none of the sampled top-40 patterns were unrecognized aside from the rename above and a low-volume (2 occurrences) generic Celery 'BROKER_POOL_LIMIT deprecated' warning, which was left out of known_noise as immaterial. No SupersetErrorException, HTTPException, or Slack-notification spikes beyond known baseline noise.
